notes.name: Voxy's Strategy
notes.effect:
Ideally, Voxy is supposed to be fought during the Soulrave (along with **Fanatic Ravers**), where they can make full use of the environmental effects of **Taking the Spotlight** by being immune to its effect and using **Star Power** every first turn as long as they have MP.
During their other turns, Voxy alternates between attacking random targets with their **Sonic Mixer** and dropping **Another Banger.**
If the players manage to complete the **Kill the Lights** clock and recover from **dazed,** Voxy then focuses on any target that's still **dazed.** If there aren't any, they use **Lightshow.**
If they don't have not enough MP, Voxy is probably already in **Crisis** and will switch to a more direct approach with the boosted Sonic Mixer or use an **Ultima Point** to recover.
If they are already in the Soulrave, they'll fight to the end, for it represents the culmination of their carreer. Otherwise, they'll always save an **Ultima Point** for their escape while taunting the players.

9CKgM1GCS7Akl0vHJ7MB.description:
Back in the day, Voxy was just a small, but proud, young musician trying to survive while playing their authorial songs in Eclipsia's underground parties and festivals.
A perfectionist, Voxy always refused to have any crew help them with their setup, always bringing it all upon themselves and their psyonic powers to give their few fans the time of their lives. But everything changed when Voxy met their current manager, Solum.
After Solum, Voxy hit the jackpot, finally becoming a mainstream superstar. The underdog background helped the media adopt Voxy as its golden, relatable, child, but all that attention eventually snapped something inside Voxy's mind.
They were never humble, but after tasting fame, they took it up a notch. Voxy's psyonic powers were mainly used for telekinetically setting up the stage, but with time they developed it to straight up influence their fans minds and feelings and boost their ego and fame, all of this while the media still support their actions and distracts the general public of the more scandalous allegations involving the DJ.
Now being too big to fail, Voxy set up their newfound empire around the Soulrave, their own music festival that is just an excuse to be a literal cult of personality.
